find: if (cells.every(([c, r]) => r === r0 || c === c0)) return { run: Math.max(w, h), arm: Math.min(w, h) - 1 };
replace: if (cells.every(([c, r]) => r === r0 || c === c0)) return { run: Math.min(w, h), arm: Math.max(w, h) - 1 };
why: An L's legs read the wrong way round: the arm is reported as the straight run and the run as the arm, so the run-length distribution states arm lengths as straights. `runs` draws the arm shorter than the straight for every length it uses, which is what makes the longer leg the run.
killedBy: the run-length read-back (issue #1029) reads a straight run, and an L's longer leg as the run and its shorter leg less the corner as the arm
